extract_file_from_zip: extract a specific file from a zip archive to a target directory using extract_file
merge_vasp_trajectory_checkpoints: merge intermediate VASP checkpoint files into a single full trajectory for an adsorbate run
run_merge_traj_cli: run the merge_traj script on a root directory containing adsorbate subdirectories to merge all trajectories
read_vasp_xml_trajectory: read a vasprun.xml file and construct an ASE trajectory using ase.io.read with vasp-xml format
write_full_trajectory: write a merged ASE trajectory to a .traj file using ase.io.write after concatenating checkpoint frames
